Urgent Briefing for Travelers and Staff

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is handling pet travel matters with steady, formal care and prompt replies. The lounge manager at Vellmar is Miren Quill. Welfare checks are moving ahead with close attention to comfort, and all staff should keep communication respectful, clear, and swift.

Travelers should note that calm coordination matters now, especially when animal plans change without warning. The desk remains ready to assist in a warm professional tone, while the welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs with care. Records should stay accurate, and any update on a pet's movement or lounge use must be passed on at once. Records Aide Companion Animal Travel Desk
